message.content: In Christianity, Jesus Christ is regarded as the central figure and is considered the most important prophet. He is seen as the Son of God and the Savior, whose teachings and life form the foundation of Christian faith. Other prophets such as Moses, Isaiah, and Jeremiah are also highly respected, but Jesus is viewed as the ultimate fulfillment of prophetic tradition.
